$comment: The Compose subset an app backend may use (D310): the allowlist that @pithyx/cli (pithyx validate) and the box both read, so they judge a backend/compose.yaml alike. Every key not listed under `top`, `service` or a nested `keys` is refused with app.compose.key_unsupported. `type` names a check both validators implement; `right` names the elevated right of the manifest's backend.elevated that the key needs (checked in both directions). Patterns match the whole value. The box rewrites the file before use (project name, network, user, logging, mounts, limits, labels), so keys it sets itself are refused here. This file is a stable contract: allowing a key or loosening a limit is a minor change, anything else a major one.

services.description: The containers of the backend, by service name.

volumes.description: Named volumes, declared without options. Each one is a folder in the app's dataset, or a storage request of the manifest with the same id.

image.description: The image, pinned by digest. The box takes the image for its architecture from `backend/images.lock.json`.

command.description: Replaces the command of the image.

entrypoint.description: Replaces the entrypoint of the image.

working_dir.description: The working directory in the container.

volumes.description: Named volumes to mount, in the short form `VOLUME:TARGET[:ro|rw]` or the long form. Host paths are refused.

depends_on.description: Services to start before this one.

test.description: The check: `NONE`, a command for the shell, `[CMD, <program>, <argument>...]` or `[CMD-SHELL, <command>]`.

timeout.description: How long one check may take.

start_period.description: The time after the start in which failed checks do not count.

start_interval.description: The time between two checks during `start_period`.

retries.description: Failed checks in a row after which the container counts as unhealthy.

disable.description: Switches the health check of the image off.

healthcheck.description: The health check of the container; it replaces the one of the image.

expose.description: Ports the service listens on for the other services of the app. Nothing is published on the host.

read_only.description: Mounts the root file system of the container read-only.

init.description: Runs an init process as PID 1 that forwards signals and reaps child processes.

stop_signal.description: The signal that stops the container, for example `SIGTERM` or `SIGINT`.

stop_grace_period.description: How long the box waits after the stop signal before it kills the container.

mem_limit.description: The memory limit, with a unit.

cpus.description: The CPU limit in cores, for example `0.5` or `2`.

labels.description: Labels of the container. Keys under `com.pithyx` and `com.docker` are reserved.

network_mode.description: `host`: the container uses the host's network instead of the app's internal network.

pid.description: `host`: the container sees the processes of the host.

devices.description: Device nodes, `HOST[:CONTAINER[:PERMISSIONS]]`; each device needs its own right `device:<host path>`.

cap_drop.description: Linux capabilities to drop, without the `CAP_` prefix.

cap_add.description: Linux capabilities to add, without the `CAP_` prefix; each one needs its own right `capability:<NAME>`.

privileged.description: A privileged container. The key needs `host.full`, which this version of Pithyx refuses.

type.description: `volume` or `tmpfs`. `bind` is refused: host paths are never mounted.

source.description: The named volume, declared under the top-level `volumes`. Not allowed for `tmpfs`.

read_only.description: Mounts the volume read-only. Required for a storage request with `read` access.

condition.description: When the other service counts as ready: started (the default in Compose), healthy, or finished with exit code 0.

restart.description: Restarts this service when Compose restarts the other one.

required.description: As in Compose; the other service must still be in this file.

dev.$comment: backend/compose.dev.yaml, the source form that `pithyx build` reads; the box never reads it. It sits next to the manifest's backend.compose with `.dev` before the extension (backend/compose.yaml and backend/compose.dev.yaml). Every rule of this file applies, plus `build`, and each service has exactly one of `image` and `build`. `build` is a folder relative to the file, as a string or as `context`, with an optional `dockerfile` relative to it (default Dockerfile; its name is a Dockerfile name of catalog.v1.rules.json), a `target` stage and `args` with values. pithyx build builds those services, tags them as <prefix>/<id>/<service>:<version>, and writes backend/compose.yaml with each `build` replaced by the image pinned by digest, plus backend/images.lock.json; services with `image` are copied as they are. A catalog builds from this file and every FROM of its Dockerfiles must be pinned by digest.

build.description: Where `pithyx build` builds the image of the service: a context folder relative to the file, or a map. `compose.yaml` gets the built image pinned by digest instead.

context.description: The build context, a folder relative to the Compose file.

dockerfile.description: The Dockerfile relative to the context; default `Dockerfile`.

target.description: The stage of a multi-stage Dockerfile to build.

args.description: Build arguments, as a map or as a list of `NAME=value`.

top.name: the box sets the project name pithyx-<id>
top.networks: the box creates the app's network
top.secrets: reads files or the box's environment
top.configs: reads files or the box's environment
top.x-*: useless without anchors, which are refused

service.ports: backends are reached only through the proxy
service.networks: the box attaches the app's network
service.links: service names resolve on the app's network
service.secrets: reads files or the box's environment
service.configs: reads files or the box's environment
service.container_name: the box names containers per project
service.user: the box sets the app uid, or root with backend.root
service.group_add: the box adds the share groups of mapped storage
service.pids_limit: the box sets 1024 against fork bombs
service.oom_score_adj: the box sets it so app containers go before its own services
service.security_opt: could switch off seccomp, AppArmor or no-new-privileges
service.gpus: needs a runtime the box does not ship
service.runtime: needs a runtime the box does not ship
service.userns_mode: host would switch off the user namespace
service.ipc: host or another container's IPC namespace
service.dns: the app's network resolves service names
service.hostname: not needed on the app's network
service.domainname: not needed on the app's network
service.platform: images come per architecture from images.lock.json
service.pull_policy: the box loads or pulls by digest itself
service.develop: no development mode on the box (D307)
service.x-*: useless without anchors, which are refused

volume.driver: volumes are folders in the app's dataset
volume.driver_opts: could mount any device or host path
volume.name: reaches volumes outside the app

mount.volume: subpath and nocopy are not needed

descriptions.$comment: Documentation only, read by the website's reference (reference/compose-rules); the validators ignore it.

types.services: A map from service name (pattern `serviceName`) to a service, at least one and at most `services` entries.
types.volumeDeclarations: A map from volume name (pattern `volumeName`) to an empty value (`data:` or `data: {}`), at most `volumes` entries. Options are refused.
types.image: A string matching `image`. Without `@sha256:` it is refused as `unpinned`; longer than `imageChars` is refused.
types.command: A string, or a list of strings.
types.environment: A map from name to a string, a whole number or a boolean, or a list of `NAME=value`. Names match `envName` and appear once; every variable has a value.
types.labels: A map from key to a string, a whole number, a boolean or nothing, or a list of `key=value`. Keys match `labelKey`, appear once and do not start with a reserved prefix.
types.string: A string. A plain scalar that YAML reads as null, a boolean or a number is refused: quote it. With a pattern, the string must match it.
types.int: A whole number between the rule's minimum and maximum.
types.object: A map with only the listed keys.
types.duration: A Compose duration such as `30s`, `1m30s` or `500ms` (units `h`, `m`, `s`, `ms`, `us`), between the rule's minimum and maximum.
types.byteSize: A number of bytes, or a number with the unit `b`, `k`, `m` or `g` (also `kb`, `mb`, `gb`; powers of 1024), above 0 and at most the rule's maximum.
types.cpus: A number of cores above 0 with at most three decimals, as a number or a string, at most the limit `cpus`.
types.mounts: A list of mounts, each in the short form `VOLUME:TARGET[:ro|rw]` or the long form. Two mounts of a service cannot share a target.
types.tmpfs: A path, or a list of `PATH[:OPTIONS]`. The only options are `size` (a byte size up to `tmpfsSizeBytes`) and `mode` (octal).
types.dependsOn: A list of service names, or a map from service name to the long form.
types.healthTest: A string for the shell, or a list: `[NONE]`, `[CMD, <program>, <argument>...]` or `[CMD-SHELL, <command>]`.
types.ports: A list of ports or port ranges `a-b`, optionally with `/tcp` or `/udp`, from 1 to 65535.
types.devices: A list of `HOST[:CONTAINER[:PERMISSIONS]]` with paths matching `devicePath` and permissions `r`, `w` or `rw`. Each host device appears once.
types.capabilities: A list of capability names matching `capability`, each once.
types.build: A context folder as a string, or a map with the keys of `build`.

limits.fileBytes: The largest Compose file, in bytes.
limits.depth: The deepest nesting of maps and lists.
limits.entries: The most entries of one list or map inside a service, such as `environment` or `volumes`.
limits.tmpfsSizeBytes: The largest tmpfs, in a `tmpfs` entry or a long-form mount.

patterns.image: Image references with an optional registry, an optional tag and the digest.
patterns.imageDigest: Whether a reference is pinned by digest at all.
patterns.envName: Names of environment variables and build arguments.
patterns.containerPath: Absolute paths in a container, without `:`, `\` or control characters; `.` and `..` segments are refused as well.
patterns.capability: Linux capability names without the `CAP_` prefix.
patterns.signal: Signal names, optionally with `+n` for a real-time signal.
patterns.port: Ports and port ranges with an optional protocol.
patterns.memorySize: Sizes that must have a unit, for `mem_limit`.
patterns.tmpfsMode: The octal mode of a tmpfs.
patterns.buildPath: Build contexts relative to the Compose file, at most 16 segments.
patterns.dockerfilePath: Dockerfile names: `Dockerfile` or `Containerfile` with an optional suffix, or `<name>.Dockerfile`, in at most 15 folders.
